episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the concept of 'Separation Season,' a time when agents can differentiate themselves by maintaining consistent effort during slower periods. He emphasizes the importance of mindset, continuous lead generation, and client relationship management. The episode provides actionable strategies for agents to prepare for future success by focusing on fundamentals and expanding their network.
